checks.detail: max |eps - eps^T| = 9.537e-06 against a tensor scale of 7.334e+01 (relative 1.300e-07). R^T diag(n^2) R is symmetric for any rotation R, so this checks the rotation composition as well as the assembly.
checks.name: the_permittivity_tensor_is_symmetric_at_every_voxel

checks.detail: max off-diagonal magnitude 1.820e+01, i.e. 24.82% of the tensor scale. A diagonal-only potential would be three independent scalar problems; the rotated beads are not.
checks.name: the_rotated_beads_produce_genuinely_off_diagonal_tensors

checks.detail: for cf.linear(0) -- x-polarized light -- the energy fractions per component index are [0.0, 0.0, 1.0]: essentially all of it sits at index 2. Combined with upstream's own code (it normalises by field.u[90, 90, 2] to set the x amplitude and labels amplitude[..., 2] as 'Amplitude Ex'), the last axis is (E_z, E_y, E_x) -- the REVERSE of this project's (E_x, E_y, E_z) convention. Any coupler must transpose it.
checks.name: vectorfield_u_is_ordered_E_z_E_y_E_x

checks.detail: phase in [-3.141534, 3.141580], which is why upstream plots it with vmin=-pi, vmax=pi
checks.name: the_phase_is_wrapped_into_minus_pi_to_pi

checks.detail: the input carried 0.000e+00 of its energy outside E_x; the output carries 0.021733. That conversion is the physics this example exists to show, and it is what distinguishes a genuinely tensorial propagation from a scalar one applied three times.
checks.name: the_birefringent_sample_generates_cross_polarization

checks.detail: mean |E_y|^2 per quadrant: top_left 7.565694e-04, top_right 5.248840e-05, bottom_left 4.988705e-05, bottom_right 5.100020e-02 -- a spread of 1022.3x. The four beads differ only in their rotation matrices, so the orientation really enters the calculation rather than being averaged away.
checks.name: the_four_crystal_orientations_give_four_different_responses

demonstrates: cf.polarized_multislice_thick_sample with a per-voxel 3x3 permittivity tensor, cf.linear / plane_wave(scalar=False) for a VectorField, chromatix.utils.utils.sigmoid_taper, and the (E_z, E_y, E_x) component order of VectorField.u.
title: Scattering through 3D birefringent samples
